216 def parse_color(value, token="?"):
217     """``(r, g, b)`` in 0..1 sRGB for ``#rgb``, ``#rrggbb``, ``rgb()`` or ``oklch()``; else ``DesignError`` naming
218     the token."""
219     v = (value or "").strip().lower()
220     try:
221         m = re.match(r"^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$", v)
222         if m:
223             h = m.group(1)
224             if len(h) == 3:
225                 h = "".join(c * 2 for c in h)
226             return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) / 255.0 for i in (0, 2, 4))
227         m = re.match(r"^rgba?\(\s*([^)]*)\)$", v)
228         if m:
229             parts = [p for p in re.split(r"[\s,/]+", m.group(1)) if p][:3]
230             if len(parts) == 3:
231                 return tuple(_clamp(_num(p, 255.0) / 255.0) for p in parts)
232         m = re.match(r"^oklch\(\s*([^)]*)\)$", v)
233         if m:
234             parts = [p for p in re.split(r"[\s/]+", m.group(1)) if p][:3]
235             if len(parts) == 3:
236                 L = _num(parts[0]) if parts[0].endswith("%") else float(parts[0])
237                 C = _num(parts[1], 0.4)
238                 H = float(parts[2].replace("deg", ""))
239                 return oklch_to_srgb(L, C, H)
240     except ValueError:
241         pass
242     raise DesignError(token, "%s: colour %r cannot be parsed (#rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(), oklch())" % (token, value))
